calendarNotes: Sweetwater UHSD starts the 2025-2026 regular 7-12 school year on July 23, 2025 and ends on June 5, 2026. The student calendar lists 180 student days, Fall Break from September 22-October 3, Thanksgiving Break from November 24-28, Winter Break from December 22-January 9, and Spring Break from March 23-April 3. The calendar also lists semester end dates, legal holidays, declared holidays, and non-instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Sweetwater UHSD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for regular 7-12 students is Wednesday, July 23, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Sweetwater UHSD Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 22 through Friday, October 3, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Sweetwater UHSD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 23 through Friday, April 3, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the school year end for Sweetwater UHSD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The school year ends for regular 7-12 students on Friday, June 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Sweetwater UHSD 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Sweetwater UHSD 2025-2026 student calendar lists 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Sweetwater UHSD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Sweetwater UHSD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: Sweetwater UHSD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content: The Sweetwater UHSD 2025-2026 student calendar provides districtwide dates for grades 7-12. Families can use it to track the first day of school, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, legal holidays, declared holidays, non-instructional days, semester end dates, AP testing windows, and the school year end date.

customSections.label: How We Verify Sweetwater UHSD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Sweetwater UHSD student calendars page and published student calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, school year end, semester end dates, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, non-instructional days, and AP testing windows, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Sweetwater UHSD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
